color.note: Green-grey neutrals with one brand green (moss). Strain types and break states each own one hue; status is never told apart by hue alone.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background in both themes. The ground every screen starts from.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the tab bar and input fields, on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells: the stepper track, segmented control track, empty chart areas.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only; never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, chips and secondary buttons. Holds 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunk and every *-soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps, units and captions on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunk and moss-soft.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: The brand colour. Primary actions, selected states, the hybrid strain type. As text, on surface, surface-raised and moss-soft.

tokens.name: moss-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover state of moss fills.

tokens.name: moss-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind selected chips, the hybrid badge, active tab pill.

tokens.name: on-moss
tokens.usage: Text and icons on moss and moss-strong fills. Dark in the dark theme, never plain white.

tokens.name: resin
tokens.usage: Trichome amber. Ratings, the sativa strain type, warnings. As text, on surface, surface-raised and resin-soft.

tokens.name: resin-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the sativa badge and warning notices.

tokens.name: dusk
tokens.usage: The indica strain type. As text, on surface and dusk-soft.

tokens.name: dusk-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the indica badge.

tokens.name: tide
tokens.usage: Tolerance breaks, the CBD strain type, and positive status (saved, goal met). As text, on surface and tide-soft.

tokens.name: tide-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind break progress, the CBD badge and positive notices.

tokens.name: on-tide
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a tide fill.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors only. Always paired with a word or icon. As text, on surface, surface-raised and clay-soft.

tokens.name: clay-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind error notices and the destructive confirm row.

families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque SemiBold, self-hosted. Screen titles and big moments only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the break counter, onboarding headlines.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles under the status bar.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card titles, strain names, section headings.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, self-hosted. Chosen for legibility at small sizes and in low light.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: You have been on a break for nine days.
styles.usage: Lead copy on empty states and onboarding.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Calm, a bit sleepy. Good for the evening walk.
styles.usage: Session notes, reviews, form values. The default.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, button text, chip text.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels above lists. Sparingly.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tab bar labels, chart axes, footnotes.

groups.name: Numbers
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, self-hosted. Every quantity the user compares: grams, percentages, counts.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The value in a stat tile.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Amounts, cannabinoid percentages, times in cards and steppers.

spacing.note: 4px base. Screens use space-4 side gutters.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside chips and badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; inside compact controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; screen side gutters.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between a field and the next field.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards in a list section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of empty states and onboarding.

radius.note: Soft and organic. The leaf corner pairs radius-lg with radius-xs on opposite corners.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: The sharp corners of a leaf shape; focus-ring insets.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, badges, segmented control items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, notices, sheets' inner panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The round corners of a leaf shape; bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the tab pill, rings.

shadow.note: Two elevations, used rarely. Borders do most of the separating.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest, only where they sit on surface-sunk.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, the floating log button, toasts.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in the page colour, then 2px solid tide. Tide is used so focus never looks like selection (moss).

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls. Pair with a reason in text when possible.
